name: Kyoukan ~Eien no Inochi o Motome~
source:
In order to gain eternal life a young man made contract with a woman spirit to insult and train four girls in just 7 days time.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
为获得永恒生命，一名青年与女性幽灵订立契约，必须在短短七天内凌辱并调教四名女孩。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
